name: bielu-staticcode-analyzers-workspace
description: Root workspace for changeset-driven versioning of this repository. Not published. build/changeset/nuget-suite is the private placeholder package standing in for the version of the Bielu.StaticCode.Analyzers NuGet package.

scripts.version: changeset version && node scripts/apply-nuget-version.mjs && node scripts/ship-analyzer-releases.mjs && npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund
